title: Continuity may modulate bioelectric coefficients but does not fix them

statements.text: A tissue voltage pattern is an attractor only when the linearized network operator is positive on every non-gauge mode. Temporal continuity may modulate the measured coefficients through declared response functions, but it does not fix the couplings or make them nonzero, and microtubule oscillations stay a conditional classical sector.
statements.conditions: graded by the author as conditional, with quantum promotion open

standing.reason: The author grades the coupling as conditional and quantum promotion as open. No experiment has tested it.
